build_pixel_encoder: build a PixelEncoder to encode pixel observations through convolutional layers into feature vectors
build_feedforward_encoder: build a FeedForwardEncoder to encode state observations through an MLP trunk network
build_film_encoder: build a FiLM encoder that modulates feedforward layers with task-specific gamma and beta parameters
build_moe_encoder: build a MixtureofExpertsEncoder that selects and aggregates expert encoders based on task information
create_encoder_from_config: create an encoder from a config dict using make_encoder with the desired type and parameters
